label: Agreement in necessity, designated necessity and individuation of divine nature
term: agreement in necessity, designated necessity and individuation of divine nature
resolution: Agreement in the notion of necessity does not establish numerical identity of nature, esse or each individual’s own necessity instance. I42[8–11] is read in necessary-through-itself scope; [13–14] adds a substantive self-necessary-or-dependent designation argument. No primitive whole-essence case is excluded by renaming it composition, and formal nature difference is not automatically a missing eminent perfection. The source case splits and old three-limitation-horn proxy are not silently equated.
